review_basis.predecessor_gate: D093 coordinator gate accepted before D094

decision_rationale: The Java contract only reads owner-published multi-product integrity receipts. Each selected real receipt matches the corresponding product cache row and exact Python digest; no competing writer or data mutation was introduced.
limitations_reviewed: The audit sampled one latest stored version for each product, not all historical dates or current source fingerprints.
The zero-row branch was validated in code and mapping tests, but selected real receipts were nonempty.
